knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unknown finish is screened or referred before any disturbing work, and the decision is recorded.
A suspect backing is left undisturbed, recorded and referred. Pulling it off can release fibres.
Queensland requires a Class A licence for any amount of friable asbestos (WorkSafe Queensland page, read 2026-11-02).

practicalCriteria: Work stopped and the area closed off on a positive or unknown result
Screening record completed with item, method, result and decision
Client told of the result and the delay, without any clearance claim
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
evidenceRequired: Photographs of the material and its location
stopWorkCriteria: Positive or unknown lead or asbestos result
Work continued without a recorded decision
